common.notAllowed: You are not allowed to see this page.

lookup.title: Look up words
lookup.hint: One word or several, separated by commas or new lines (up to {{max}}).
lookup.copyFailed: The browser did not allow the copy.
lookup.tooMany: At most {{max}} words at a time.

unsaved.title: Unsaved edits
unsaved.body: Your edits to the cards are not saved. Leaving this page will discard them.
unsaved.relookup: Looking up again will discard your unsaved edits.

saved.title: Saved words
saved.count: {{count}} of {{limit}} saved words waiting for the next export.
saved.countKept: {{count}} of {{limit}} saved words, {{new}} not exported yet.
saved.exportedKept: Exported {{count}} words to {{file}}. They stay in your list, marked as exported.
saved.scopeTitle: What do you want to export?
saved.scopeMessage: {{exported}} words in your list were exported before and {{new}} are new.
saved.empty: No saved words yet. Look a word up and save it.
saved.exported: Exported {{count}} words to {{file}}. The list is empty again.
saved.noMatch: No saved word matches your search.
saved.linkTitle: Download link for the Anki app
saved.linkHint: In the Anki app choose Import, then Download link, and paste this address. It works once and stops working at {{time}}.

removePrompt.title: Remove the exported words?
removePrompt.message: Saved words are now removed after an export. {{count}} words in your list were exported before. Do you want to remove them now?

settings.title: Settings
settings.dictionariesHint: Choose the dictionaries you use and the one a lookup starts with.
settings.oneOn: Keep at least one dictionary on.
settings.deckNameHint: Used when you export your saved words as an Anki deck.
settings.removeAfterExportHint: On: exported words leave your list. Off: they stay, marked as exported, and you choose to export all or only the new ones.

errors.limit: You have reached the limit of saved words. Export the deck or delete words first.
errors.nothingToExport: There are no saved words to export.
errors.tooLarge: The deck is too large to export. Delete some words and try again.
errors.unavailable: The dictionary source is not available now. Try again later.
errors.forbidden: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.dictionaryDisabled: An administrator turned this dictionary off.
errors.imageTooLarge: The image is too large even after shrinking. Use a smaller picture.
errors.imageFormat: This file is not a supported image (PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF).
errors.imageQuota: You have used all your image storage. Remove images from your cards first.
errors.imagesDisabled: Images are not available on this server.

editor.label: Card editor
editor.audioHint: https address of a sound file; a ▶ button in the text marks where it plays.
editor.tooLarge: The card is too large (at most 64 KiB). Remove some content or images.
editor.badAudio: The audio address must be an https URL of at most 500 characters.
editor.imageUnreadable: The image could not be read. Save the image to your computer or take a screenshot, then add the file.
